decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan by playing hatebears like Chancellor of the Annex and Archon of Emeria, while also applying pressure through aggro creatures like White Plume Adventurer and Witch Enchanter. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Strip Mine and Wasteland to control the opponent's mana base. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan and take advantage of the disruption to secure a win through a combination of creature beats and disruptive plays.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Coveted Jewel and Paradoxical Outcome to generate a large amount of mana and draw cards, while also using cards like Tolarian Academy, Mishra's Workshop, and Mana artifacts to ramp up quickly. The deck also includes various control elements like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor to protect the combo. It can also potentially win the game with cards like Time Vault and Mystic Forge. Overall, the deck focuses on fast and explosive plays to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on using disruptive counter spells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce in combination with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Psychic Frog to control the pace of the game. It also utilizes powerful card draw options like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to maintain card advantage. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion enables the player to continuously recur low-cost permanents from the graveyard, providing additional value and resilience in the late game. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through a blend of control and resource management.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Ichorid, Golgari Thug, and Stinkweed Imp, then use cards like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam to bring back creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect the combo pieces. By utilizing Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to dig through the deck, the player aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence and win the game through aggressive graveyard interactions and synergy.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize various mana ramp cards such as Mishra's Workshop, Grim Monolith, and Tolarian Academy to quickly generate mana and cast powerful spells. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge, while also utilizing combo pieces like Time Vault and Voltaic Key for a quick win. Additionally, the inclusion of Coveted Jewel provides card advantage and can help further accelerate the deck's game plan. The deck also includes disruption and protection with cards like Force of Will and Trinisphere.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control elements such as counterspells, card draw, and removal to disrupt the opponent's game plan and establish control over the game. With a combination of efficient creatures, disruptive spells, and card advantage engines, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents in a 1 vs 1 match. By leveraging cards like Force of Will, Polluted Delta, and Demonic Tutor, the deck can effectively control the pace of the game, dismantle opposing strategies, and secure victory through incremental advantage and resource management.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on using disruption and card advantage to control the game. The deck also utilizes various artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Orcish Bowmasters to gain incremental advantages. With a focus on tempo and disruption, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents while maintaining control of the game.

The focus of this deck is to use the powerful graveyard interaction of Dredge cards to quickly fill the graveyard and bring back multiple creatures onto the battlefield. It aims to leverage this strategy to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures like Ichorid, Stinkweed Imp, and Prized Amalgam while using disruption spells like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap for protection. Cards like Hollow One and Creeping Chill provide additional value and aggression, while utilizing Bazaar of Baghdad for card filtering and graveyard manipulation.
